{
  "message": "Thanks — I can help. A few quick notes before I look into your specific accounts:

- How interest is calculated: Savings interest accrues on your daily balance and compounds daily; accrued interest is credited monthly. Your effective monthly amount depends on the APY (annual percentage yield) actually applied during the cycle, tiered rates for balance bands, and any qualifying APY boosts or bonuses.
- APY boosts/bonuses: If you hold multiple Rho-Bank checking accounts, only the single highest checking-account APY boost is applied to your savings (they do not stack). Similarly, if you have multiple Rho-Bank credit cards that give savings APY bonuses, only the highest card bonus is applied. However, checking boosts can stack with a (single) credit-card bonus and applicable relationship or tier bonuses.
- About your numbers: $450 on a $96,000 balance for one month annualizes to about 5.625% APY (450*12 / 96,000). Whether that’s “low” depends on the APY components that should apply to your Gold savings (base APY, tier for $96k, plus highest checking boost, plus highest credit-card bonus, plus any relationship bonus).

If you want me to investigate your specific account and confirm whether the correct APY and boosts were applied, I’ll need to verify your identity first (required to access account details). Please provide any 2 of the following so I can verify you: date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY), email on file, phone number on file, or mailing address on file. Once you provide two and I verify you, I will:

1) Retrieve your accounts and the interest credit for the period
2) Confirm which APY components should have applied (tier, checking boost, credit card bonus, relationship bonus)
3) Calculate the expected interest and compare to the $450 credited
4) If there’s a discrepancy, I can apply an interest correction credit to your savings account and file an investigation report for the backend team

Would you like me to proceed? If so, please provide two of the verification items (DOB, email, phone, or address) and confirm you authorize me to look up your accounts and run the investigation."
}
